description: §6.8.4 (RT) — the SAME source shape as tare-first-write-baseline-rt (an implicitly declared cell written twice at module-init) with the OPPOSITE intent: the merged LAST write is the baseline, so `tare(@config)` sits after both writes and reset restores the merged value. The pair exists to pin that no structural rule decides this — the author's placement of the tare does.
rationale: §6.8.4: a counter's baseline is its first write and a configuration's baseline is its last, and the two programs are structurally indistinguishable. Any compile-time last-write (or first-write) analysis is therefore wrong for one of them by construction — which is why the bare form lowers to a RUNTIME promotion of whatever init thunk is registered when the statement runs.
